title: Gas Bundle Loyalty Bonus, Residential Electricity Supply Renewals
content:
**Rule.** When a Beacon Ridge gas agreement under Residential Natural Gas Supply on the same premise as the renewing Residential Electricity Supply agreement is active and the customer's gas bill lines carry 12 or more gas energy charge lines, the established-bundle loyalty bonus of 20.00 USD is added to the renewal loyalty credit; when such a gas agreement is active and those lines number fewer than 12, the new-bundle loyalty bonus of 10.00 USD is added; when no gas agreement on the premise is active, nothing is added.

**Records read.**

- The status of the gas agreement recorded at the same premise as the electricity agreement.
- The gas energy charge lines on the customer's Residential Natural Gas Supply bill lines, counted whenever posted. Gas service fee lines and gas credit lines are not gas energy charge lines.

| Gas agreement on the premise | Gas energy charge lines on the customer's gas bills | Bundle loyalty bonus |
|---|---|---|
| active | 12 or more | 20.00 USD |
| active | fewer than 12 | 10.00 USD |
| not active, or none | any | nothing |

**Boundaries.** With an active gas agreement, 12 gas energy charge lines take 20.00 USD and 11 take 10.00 USD.
